scope: Sparse early Ki Blast Super records — direct mechanics/evidence enrichment
canonical_data_rule: Canonical data remains the source of truth. This batch records evidence candidates and does not infer unsupported acquisition/UF semantics.

records.name: Tyrant Lancer

records.promotion: ki_cost and damage evidence are candidates; damage is test-contextual and should not be treated as universal scaling.

records.promotion: Exact held cost/output needs direct in-game or skill-specific evidence before canonical promotion.

records.mechanics: Chargeable Kamehameha variant; damage-test source reports uncharged and fully charged outputs with differing hit counts.
records.promotion: Charge/damage figures are test-contextual; do not promote as universal scaling without stronger provenance.

records.name: Kamekameha

records.promotion: Identity/cost/user evidence is stronger than the damage figure; retain test-context qualifier.

notes: This batch targets four sparse records surfaced during null-field auditing. Existing Batch 254 established their identities but left costs/effects sparse. Current evidence supplies bounded enrichment without inventing acquisition or Ultimate-Finish conditions.
